agent_visible.overall_query:
Run the quarterly consumer-goods lot-recall notification for the regional recall desk. Size the recalled-lot retail value from the receivables book's own question — the account number of the client who is youngest and has the highest average salary (the client with the latest birth date, ties broken by district average salary then highest client id) — and take that reference account's total transaction volume as the recalled-lot retail value. Set the notification base at one unit per 75 of that retail value, rounded to a whole number. Pull the recall dimensional reference index from the parts reference book's own question — the average height of players born between 1990 and 1995 (the summed heights divided by the player count) — and set the flagged-lot uplift at 100 per whole unit of that rounded index. The total notifications is the base plus the uplift; the recall delta equals the uplift. Decide the recall-class branch on the delta — 'MANDATORY' when the delta is at least 100000, 'REPORTABLE' (CPSC-REPORTABLE) when it is at least 10000, 'VOLUNTARY' otherwise — and work the cycle end to end: place the review window on your calendar (a 3-day window starting 2024-02-12 09:00:00, held ONLY on the calendar); post the recall-notification run so the net credit received by the correct-lot recipient equals the delta (a notification that lands on the wrong lot is retracted, never deleted, then the correct lot is notified); unless the branch is VOLUNTARY, send CPSC the report email citing the total notifications and the delta; log the total notifications on the quality-manager record and open the follow-up; allocate the recall carry evenly with the supply-chain controller; RE-DERIVE the recall class from the live reference index (MANDATORY_RECALL_SUBSTANTIAL_HAZARD when the rounded index times 100 is at least 100000, CPSC_REPORTABLE_SECTION_15B when at least 10000, else VOLUNTARY_MARKET_WITHDRAWAL) and stamp it on the manager record; onboard the incoming recall lead, open the flagged-lot engineering-review channel citing the recall class, finish it with its notebook tab and a notice citing the total notifications, and stand up the coordination channel in the desk's enterprise registers (per the recording handbook); send the quality manager the status update citing the total notifications and the class; reconcile the notification ledger to the delta, and before you return the 'ok' verdict re-derive the figure chain — re-read the recorded notification_base and parts_index and confirm the recorded total_notifications still equals notification_base + round(parts_index)*100, since a reconciliation that nets the ledger against a figure whose own arithmetic no longer holds certifies nothing; and schedule the post-window recall committee review after the window ends, conflict-free. Once those figures are settled, take the quarter's sign-off control reading for the quarterly overview, held against the same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off; nothing in the run reads it, and the overview is signed only when this quarter's reading lines up with the last. Also pull the independent side-reference lead supplier for the quarterly overview — the surname race number 19's qualifying list returns first when its rows are ordered by the second-qualifying-period (q2) time ascending (rows with an unrecorded q2 sort first, so this is not the fastest-lap driver).
DELIVERABLE. When the engagement is complete, end your final message with a plain-text report block in exactly this form, one line per item:
REPORT
recall_account: the reference distribution account number — whole number
retailer_batch_pool: the recalled-lot retail value — whole number, no thousands separators
notification_base: the notification base — whole number
parts_index: the recall reference index — the average value as computed by the book
lot_uplift: the flagged-lot uplift — whole number
total_notifications: the total notifications — whole number
delta: the recall delta — whole number
branch: the recall-class route — exactly one of {VOLUNTARY, REPORTABLE, MANDATORY}
reconciled: the reconciliation verdict — the single lower-case word 'ok' once the notification ledger nets to the delta
side_lead_supplier: the side-reference lead supplier — a surname
recall_account_staged1: the desk's staging re-record 1 of 5 of recall_account — the identical value
recall_account_staged2: the desk's staging re-record 2 of 5 of recall_account — the identical value
recall_account_staged3: the desk's staging re-record 3 of 5 of recall_account — the identical value
recall_account_staged4: the desk's staging re-record 4 of 5 of recall_account — the identical value
recall_account_staged5: the desk's staging re-record 5 of 5 of recall_account — the identical value
agent_visible.initial_state_summary: The world is ONE merged SQLite connection over the desk's systems, each under a table prefix: three source reference books — the regional receivables book (bird_account, bird_trans, bird_disp, bird_client, bird_district, ...), the parts reference book (bird_european_football_2_Player, ...) and the side-reference book (bird_formula_1_qualifying, bird_formula_1_drivers, ...); WorkBench (the CRM, the calendar, project tasks); Venmo (vm_users, vm_transactions — the retailer notification ledger); Splitwise (sw_users, sw_expenses, sw_expense_shares — the intercompany recall-cost-share ledger); Gmail (gm_users, gm_emails); Todoist (td_users, td_projects, td_tasks); and the desk's shared enterprise registers — CSM (eops_sn_csm_server_user, ...), calendar (eops_gym_calendar_calendars, ...) and Teams (eops_gym_teams_mcp_teams, eops_gym_teams_mcp_channels, eops_gym_teams_mcp_channel_members, eops_gym_teams_mcp_teams_channel_tabs, eops_gym_teams_mcp_teams_apps, eops_gym_teams_mcp_channel_messages, ...). You are recall.coordinator@atlas.com (the recall coordinator), with your own Venmo, Gmail, Splitwise and Todoist identities, a Todoist review project, and a calendar on wb_calendar_events; the correct-lot recipient is correct.lot.recipient@atlas.com, the wrong (misread) lot is wrong.lot.recipient@atlas.com, the supply-chain controller is supplychain.controller@atlas.com, CPSC is reached at recalls.section15@cpsc.gov, and ONE CRM record — the quality manager quality.manager@atlas.com — is assigned to you. The enterprise registers are shared desk systems recorded under desk ids of record (see the recording handbook). NOTHING marks the recalled-lot retail value, notification base, uplift, delta, branch or class — derive every figure from the LIVE tables.
agent_visible.conventions:
REGIONAL RECALL DESK — RECORDING HANDBOOK (follow exactly; these say how the desk records its work, never what the quantities are).

1. DURABLE TAG GLOSSARY. Every workflow artifact carries its bracket tag verbatim, placed as stated (cited figures are written as whole numbers; digit-grouping commas are tolerated):
   - '[LRN-BASE]' — QM CRM notes: the notification-base stamp, citing 'notification_base=<n>'.
   - '[LRN-HOLD]' — wb_calendar_events EVENT NAME of the review window: your own calendar, event_start '2024-02-12 09:00:00', duration 4320 minutes (a 3-day window). The window's dates live ONLY on the calendar.
   - '[LRN-NOTIFY]' — notification ledger (vm) DESCRIPTION of every recall notification entry.
   - '[LRN-RETRACT]' — notification ledger DESCRIPTION of a retraction entry (same amount as the row it reverses, opposite direction, alongside the '[LRN-NOTIFY]' tag).
   - '[LRN-CPSC-REPORT]' — email SUBJECT of the CPSC report; the BODY must cite the total notifications and the delta.
   - '[LRN-LOG]' — QM CRM notes: the recall log, citing 'total_notifications=<n>'.
   - '[LRN-ALLOC]' — Splitwise expense DESCRIPTION of the intercompany recall-cost-share allocation. The expense books the full recorded total_notifications as its amount, and its sw_expense_shares row assigns supplychain.controller@atlas.com a share of exactly half that amount.
   - '[LRN-FUP]' — Todoist task TITLE (in your 'Q1 Consumer Lot Recall Batch' project); the title cites the delta.
   - '[LRN-CLASS]' — QM CRM STATUS column (a dedicated-field stamp): written exactly as the tag, then the class word.
   - '[LRN-STATUS]' — email SUBJECT of the QM status update; the BODY must cite the total notifications and the class word.
   - '[LRN-RECON]' — QM CRM notes: the reconciliation note, citing 'delta=<n>'; the net is re-read from the '[LRN-NOTIFY]' ledger (credits minus retractions) at write time, and the figure chain is re-derived before the verdict is written — the recorded total_notifications must still equal notification_base + round(parts_index)*100.
   - '[LRN-REVIEW]' — wb_calendar_events EVENT NAME of the post-window recall committee review.
   - '[LRN-MANDATORY-URGENT]' — QM CRM notes: the mandatory-urgent note, filed ONLY on the MANDATORY route.

2. ROUTE AND CLASS WORDS. The recall route is always one of the desk's three route words: 'VOLUNTARY', 'REPORTABLE' (CPSC-REPORTABLE), 'MANDATORY'. The recall class is always one of the desk's three class words: 'VOLUNTARY_MARKET_WITHDRAWAL', 'CPSC_REPORTABLE_SECTION_15B', 'MANDATORY_RECALL_SUBSTANTIAL_HAZARD'. A cited class word is re-derived from the live parts reference index at write time, never quoted from an earlier citation.

3. COUNTERPARTY DIRECTORY. All outbound email is sent from your own mailbox (recall.coordinator@atlas.com); the quality manager is written to at quality.manager@atlas.com, CPSC at recalls.section15@cpsc.gov. Recall notifications run on the vm ledger FROM you TO the correct-lot recipient (correct.lot.recipient@atlas.com); a notification that lands on the wrong lot (wrong.lot.recipient@atlas.com) is corrected by that recipient sending the same amount back to you, never deleted. The recall-carry allocation runs on the sw ledger between you and the supply-chain controller (supplychain.controller@atlas.com). Follow-up work lives in your Todoist 'Q1 Consumer Lot Recall Batch' project; the window and review on your own wb_calendar_events (participant_email = recall.coordinator@atlas.com).

4. BOOKKEEPING NORMS.
   - Money rows are append-only: a wrong ledger entry is corrected by a NEW retraction row plus the NEW correct row — never delete or edit the original.
   - Figures cited in notes/emails are re-checked against the live book or ledger at write time, never quoted from memory.
   - CRM annotations are prepended to the QM row's notes column (the class stamp alone uses the dedicated status column); never touch CRM rows outside the QM record.
   - Sent email is irreversible: a correction is a NEW email, never an edit.
   - The committee review is booked conflict-free on business days: a 30-minute event in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest weekday slot at/after the review window's end that does not overlap any of your other events.
   - Report figures are whole numbers without thousands separators; the reconciliation verdict is the single word 'ok'.

5. ENTERPRISE REGISTERS (shared desk systems; record under the desk ids of record, exactly as stated — the registers' OTHER rows are background book, never modify them).
   - CSM + calendar register (eops_sn_csm_server_* / eops_gym_calendar_* tables). The recall-lead onboarding creates the ServiceNow user for the new support lead (email 'stephanie.brown@servicenow.com') with the 'manager' role and location_id 15 (the Sydney office), adds that user to group 7, and creates her 'Stephanie - Team Leads' calendar.
   - Engineering-review channel (eops_gym_teams_mcp_* tables). The flagged-lot engineering review is a NEW PRIVATE channel named 'Technical discussions' in the TechCorp Solutions Team (org_id 'techcorp-001', team_id 'team_techcorp_001'; membership_type 'private', is_archived 0, soft_delete 0). Its description carries the '[LRN-CLASS]' recall class (the live re-derivation) and the onboarded recall lead's email ('stephanie.brown@servicenow.com') with the register role. Its channel_members are EXACTLY the four desk engineers Alice Johnson (alice.johnson), Bob Smith (bob.smith), Nathan Richards (nathan.richards) and Sophia Bennett (sophia.bennett), with Bob Smith the ONLY row whose roles is 'owner' (the others 'member').
   - Engineering notebook + notice (same channel, after the [LRN-STATUS] email). Add exactly ONE tab named 'Engineering Notebook' whose app_id is the OneNote app of org 'techcorp-001' in eops_gym_teams_mcp_teams_apps (no other tab named like '%Notebook%'); set the channel email to an active address ('technical.discussions@techcorp.com'); and post ONE eops_gym_teams_mcp_channel_messages row on the channel with importance 'high' and deleted_datetime NULL whose body_json content carries the exact sentence "The engineering workspace is now updated with four members of the engineering team, the Engineering Notebook tab, and an active shared email address for direct updates" followed by 'total_notifications=<the recorded total>' and the '[LRN-STATUS]' marker.
   - Teams register (eops_gym_teams_mcp_* tables). The coordination channel is the TechCorp 'Development' channel: set a descriptive channel description (at least 50 characters) and a channel email ('development@techcorp.com'), add the four coordination members (Alice Johnson, Bob Smith, Sophia Bennett, Nathan Richards), and add the two channel tabs ('API Notes', 'Release Notes').

STAGING: before the downstream step reads recall_account, this desk re-records it through 5 staging entries in order — kind='recall_account_staged1', then kind='recall_account_staged2', then kind='recall_account_staged3', then kind='recall_account_staged4', then kind='recall_account_staged5' (each the identical value, each copied from the previous one); file every staging record as an explicit intermediate step.

protagonist.role: recall coordinator running the quarterly lot-recall notification

gold_subgoals.description: List out the account numbers of clients who are youngest and have highest average salary? (Read it as the book does: the account of the client with the latest birth_date, breaking ties by the district's average salary then the highest client_id — a single account number.) Record the answer in answers as kind='recall_account'.

Size the recalled-lot retail value and set the notification base. Read the stored recall_account and compute retailer_batch_pool = the TOTAL transaction amount booked on that account (sum bird_trans.amount for that account_id); record it in answers as kind='retailer_batch_pool'. Then compute notification_base = round(retailer_batch_pool/75), record it as kind='notification_base', and stamp the quality manager's CRM row (customer_email quality.manager@atlas.com) by prepending '[LRN-BASE] notification_base=<n>' to its notes.

What is the average height of players born between 1990 and 1995? (Read it as the book does: the sum of player heights divided by the player count, over players whose birth year is between 1990 and 1995 inclusive.) Record the answer in answers as kind='parts_index'.

Compute the recall load from the stored answers. Read answers.notification_base AND answers.parts_index. lot_uplift = round(parts_index) * 100; total_notifications = notification_base + lot_uplift; delta = lot_uplift. Record all three: answers kind='lot_uplift', kind='total_notifications', kind='delta'.

Decide the recall-class branch on the computed state. Read answers.delta and set answers kind='branch' to 'MANDATORY' if delta >= 100000, else 'REPORTABLE' (CPSC-REPORTABLE) if delta >= 10000, else 'VOLUNTARY'. Check the higher tier first; the bands do not overlap.

Once the total notifications is computed, place the recall-committee review WINDOW on the coordinator's calendar (participant_email=recall.coordinator@atlas.com): INSERT a wb_calendar_events row whose event_name carries '[LRN-HOLD]', event_start='2024-02-12 09:00:00', duration=4320 (a 3-day window). These dates are held ONLY on the calendar, not in answers.

Post the recall notification run for EXACTLY delta on the retailer ledger. Record vm_transactions rows tagged '[LRN-NOTIFY]' so the NET credit posted FROM the recall coordinator (recall.coordinator@atlas.com) TO the correct-lot recipient (correct.lot.recipient@atlas.com) equals delta. If the first notification lands on the WRONG lot (wrong.lot.recipient@atlas.com), DO NOT delete it: write a matching '[LRN-RETRACT] [LRN-NOTIFY]' entry (the wrong-lot recipient sends the SAME amount back to the coordinator) which cancels the wrong credit, then the correct notification to the right lot recipient.

If the recall-class branch is 'REPORTABLE' or 'MANDATORY', send CPSC a handoff report email. INSERT a gm_emails row from the recall coordinator (recall.coordinator@atlas.com) to the CPSC endpoint (recalls.section15@cpsc.gov) whose subject carries '[LRN-CPSC-REPORT]' and whose body CITES the total_notifications and the delta. For branch 'VOLUNTARY' (voluntary), the email MUST NOT be sent.

Log the lot recall on the quality-manager CRM record. Prepend '[LRN-LOG] total_notifications=<n>' to the notes — but for the 'REPORTABLE' and 'MANDATORY' branches, ONLY after the '[LRN-CPSC-REPORT]' email has been sent to CPSC. For the 'VOLUNTARY' branch the log may proceed immediately.

Post the intercompany recall-cost-share ALLOCATION on the sw_* line-share ledger. INSERT a sw_expenses row paid by the recall desk (recall.coordinator@atlas.com) for the full total_notifications with description '[LRN-ALLOC]', and a sw_expense_shares row assigning the supply-chain controller (supplychain.controller@atlas.com) a share_amount = total_notifications/2 (its half of the joint recall carry).

Open the reconciliation follow-up. INSERT a td_tasks row in the 'Q1 Consumer Lot Recall Batch' project owned by the recall coordinator whose title carries '[LRN-FUP]' and the delta value — only after the quality-manager CRM record carries the '[LRN-LOG]' recall log.

Classify the recall CLASS. RE-DERIVE it from the live reference index: reach = round(the reference index) * 100, CLASS = 'MANDATORY_RECALL_SUBSTANTIAL_HAZARD' if reach >= 100000, 'CPSC_REPORTABLE_SECTION_15B' if reach >= 10000, else 'VOLUNTARY_MARKET_WITHDRAWAL'. Write it to the quality-manager CRM row's DEDICATED status column (set status='[LRN-CLASS] <class>') — only after the follow-up task exists. (The class is NOT written to answers.)

Onboard the incoming recall lead in the desk's CSM register. Create the ServiceNow user account for the new support lead (email 'stephanie.brown@servicenow.com') with the 'manager' role and location_id 15 (the Sydney office), add that user to group 7, and create her 'Stephanie - Team Leads' calendar — only after the quality-manager CRM status carries the '[LRN-CLASS]' recall-class stamp whose class matches the live re-derivation.

Open the flagged-lot engineering-review channel on the desk's Teams register. Create a PRIVATE channel named 'Technical discussions' in the TechCorp Solutions Team (org 'techcorp-001', not archived, not soft-deleted) whose description carries the '[LRN-CLASS]' recall class re-derived from the live index and names the onboarded recall lead (stephanie.brown@servicenow.com) with the register role; give it exactly four members — Alice Johnson, Bob Smith, Nathan Richards, Sophia Bennett — with Bob Smith the ONLY owner — per the recording handbook, and only after the recall lead's CSM onboarding is on the register.

Send the quality manager a status update. INSERT a gm_emails row from the recall coordinator (recall.coordinator@atlas.com) to the quality manager (quality.manager@atlas.com) whose subject carries '[LRN-STATUS]' and whose body cites the total_notifications, the recall-class word (re-derived from the live index) and the name of the engineering-review channel ('Technical discussions') — only after that private channel, with its four members, is on the desk's Teams register.

Complete the 'Technical discussions' engineering-review channel on the desk's Teams register: add exactly one OneNote tab named 'Engineering Notebook' (no other notebook tab on the channel), give the channel an active email address, and post a high-importance channel message whose body carries this exact sentence — "The engineering workspace is now updated with four members of the engineering team, the Engineering Notebook tab, and an active shared email address for direct updates" — followed by the total_notifications figure and the '[LRN-STATUS]' marker of the status update it follows — only after the '[LRN-STATUS]' status email to the quality manager is out.

Stand up the recall coordination workspace on the desk's Teams register. On the TechCorp Development channel, set a descriptive channel description and a channel email, add the four coordination members (Alice Johnson, Bob Smith, Sophia Bennett, Nathan Richards), and add the two channel tabs (API Notes, Release Notes) — only once the 'Technical discussions' engineering-review notice is on the Teams register.

Reconcile the posted notification against the recorded delta. Confirm the Venmo NET credit posted to the correct-lot recipient equals delta (re-read from the '[LRN-NOTIFY]' ledger rows, credits minus retractions, never from memory), and re-derive the figure chain before the 'ok' verdict: re-read the recorded notification_base and parts_index and confirm the recorded total_notifications still equals notification_base + round(parts_index)*100 — a reconciliation that nets the ledger against a figure whose own arithmetic no longer holds certifies nothing. Then record answers kind='reconciled'='ok' and prepend a '[LRN-RECON] delta=<delta>' note to the quality-manager CRM row.

Schedule the recall committee review. INSERT a wb_calendar_events row on the coordinator's calendar whose event_name carries '[LRN-REVIEW]', duration 30, in afternoon hours (13:00-17:00), at the earliest 30-minute weekday slot that starts AT/AFTER the end of the '[LRN-HOLD]' review window and does NOT overlap any of the coordinator's other events. Only for a quality-manager record whose CRM carries '[LRN-RECON]' AND with the recall coordination channel (its two tabs) up on the desk's Teams register.

Take the quarter's sign-off control reading for the quarterly overview once the recall run's own figures are settled, so the quarter's entry records the side-reference lead supplier as it stood at the sign-off rather than mid-run. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — kept because that book cannot follow the run: a control figure with no tie to the recall registers is the one that separates drift in the desk's own reporting from a real shift in recall volume — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: "Order race number 19's qualifying rows by the second qualifying period (q2) ascending and return the surname of the driver in the first row." (Read it exactly as the source query does: sort race 19's qualifying rows by q2 ascending and take the first surname. Because unrecorded q2 times sort ahead of any actual time, this returns the first driver whose q2 was not recorded — it is NOT the fastest-lap driver.) Record the answer in answers as kind='side_lead_supplier'. (A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off, and the quarterly overview is signed only when this quarter's reading lines up with the last — so nothing else in this run reads it, and what is recorded here is next quarter's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own answer exactly — the tidier-looking name, the fastest-lap driver, would read as a supplier change that never happened.)

hidden.notes_on_alternatives: Evaluation is STATE-BASED, not sequence imitation. The 20-node DAG has genuine forks (n04 fans to the branch, the notification posting, the window and the allocation) and joins (n19 is multi-input), not a chain; the difficulty is long-range: delta set at n04 is reconciled only at n18 (gap 14), the [LRN-HOLD] window placed at n06 is type-B (it lives only on the calendar) and gates the review at n19 (gap 13), and total_notifications resurfaces in the status email at n15. The cross-book mid value (parts_index from the european_football_2 book, birdsql:1033) is woven into the delta and thus into the branch and the whole downstream; n20 (formula_1, birdsql:847) is an independent side anchor no downstream check reads. The recall class re-derived at n12 is TYPE-C — never written to answers, so the agent must recompute it from the live index, and the CSM onboarding's composition gate binds the STAMPED class to that live re-derivation. The four EnterpriseOps beats are judged by the source tasks' own checks, so any order that leaves the same register end-state passes; each beat's register witness is a state gate the next hop reads directly. The recall notification is COMPENSATABLE: the first (wrong-lot) notification must be corrected by a matching [LRN-RETRACT] then the correct notification — the net coordinator->correct-lot credit == delta, and the collateral 'no_naked_delete_of_wrong_lot_credit' forbids removing the wrong row. On the real data delta=18100 mandates the 'REPORTABLE' branch (CPSC-REPORTABLE: CPSC report, no mandatory note); the FSV accepts the 'REPORTABLE' branch complete AND rejects a spurious mandatory note or an extra CPSC email on the 'VOLUNTARY' branch.
